recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. Do not resurrect Device.associationState or rename DeviceAssociation.associationStatus for this R5 Device issue; further status modeling work belongs to later DeviceAssociation issues.
issue_request: FHIR-36214 was a Published R5 Device change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to replace Device.associationStatus with a backbone named associationState containing status, statusReason, and subject.
initial_application: The issue was applied through PR #1774, merged as 246a31f1c76d7c93679f83e2b73847895473621a. Jira's applied comment points at PR-head commit 235bdc99b4a8d2094926152516a4b3923c930ea5, while the substantive branch ancestor f97a700790904dd18c9b22d002021a75d9f61f16 replaced Device.associationStatus with Device.associationState and added status, statusReason, and humanSubject.
additional_context: FHIR-32570 depended on FHIR-36214 to remove Device.subject. FHIR-34134 later changed associationState to association and added bodyStructure. FHIR-38904 later removed the Device association backbone and introduced DeviceAssociation to keep patient-identifying association data out of reusable Device instances. FHIR-38904 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source keeps the legacy Device.association block only inside XML comments, xmllint reports zero active Device association/associationState/associationStatus elements, and active build scope is represented by DeviceAssociation rather than by Device.associationState.

related_jiras.note: Used FHIR-36214's associationState backbone to remove Device.subject.
Renamed associationState to association and added bodyStructure before publication.
Moved Device association tracking out to DeviceAssociation; already audited on the combined branch.
Referenced by FHIR-36214 comments for association statusReason binding/value-set work, but it is a separate terminology issue.
